english.note: Use 咚咚聲 when the heavy footsteps are being referred to specifically as a thudding sound.

examples.english: We heard the trample of heavy footsteps coming from upstairs all night.
examples.traditional: 我哋成晚都聽到樓上傳嚟嘅咚咚聲。
